intro: More than a seat, Opulent brings expression to the table. Tufted detailing, soft foam, and a 360° swivel—comfort designed to keep up with connection.

features.title: Designed to lean with your comfort
features.text: With a sleek, angled backrest, our chair encourages natural recline—so you sit in ease, not stiffness.

features.title: A seat that moves with you
features.text: The 360° swivel mechanism adds freedom and flexibility—so you’re always part of the conversation.

features.title: Built with strength you can feel
features.text: A solid wood and ply frame, reinforced with sheesham wood, offers reliable support that stands the test of time.

features.title: Upholstery made to endure
features.text: The premium PVC surface resists scratches, abrasions, and peeling—keeping your chair looking polished, meal after meal.

features.title: We make cleanup feel effortless
features.text: Our easy-to-clean finish lets you wipe away spills or smudges quickly—so your dining setup always feels fresh.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
